title: A search over the reinforcement-learning settings of the discovery controller
description: Step 2's settings search for compact's discovery controller, at 10 latents, the middle of the widths that are grounded (7, 10 and 16). The one point run so far (experiments/controller-rl.json) left the controllers with latents below their references without an encoder and unsteady between seeds, and its learner took steps about twice the reference's: over the last 40 iterations, at width 10, 23% of decisions were clipped and the step's KL was 0.019, against 11% and 0.009. So the search is over what sets the size of the step and of the exploration: the learning rate (0.00003, 0.0001, 0.0003), PPO's clip (0.1, 0.2) and the exploration noise in log2 of the window (0.1, 0.2), a full grid of 12 points. Each point trains from the clone of Cubic and from the clone of BBRv3 (read from the bootstrap's release), seeds 1 and 2: 48 runs. Everything else is as in controller-rl.json: 120 iterations of 8 links with 4 rollouts each, 30 s episodes, noise held for 20 steps, reward horizon 1 s, the first 3 iterations update the value network alone, no anchor to the start, stopping at 4 h. The point learning rate 0.0003, clip 0.2, noise 0.2 is that earlier point again. Evaluation: before training, every 20 iterations and for the policy the run leaves, without noise on the 21 validation links under 6 conditions. What is read, by rules fixed here before the run (experiments/settings_search.py). (1) A run's score is that of the policy it leaves. (2) A point's score per teacher is the mean over its two seeds, and points are ranked by it; the fixed rule it is written against is the same for every point. (3) The two best points per teacher go on to a confirmation over more seeds, at widths 7, 10 and 16 with the reference; this run chooses candidates and supports no claim. (4) Scores are also given apart for conditions with and without a competing flow. The test links are not read.
run: R="ctl-$TEACHER-k10-s$SEED"; T="$R-lr$LR-c$CLIP-n$NOISE"; S="$OUT/spec-$T.json"; jq --arg from "$IN/runs/$R" --argjson seed "$SEED" --argjson lr "$LR" --argjson clip "$CLIP" --argjson noise "$NOISE" '.algo = "ppo" | .init_from = $from | .inputs = "raw" | .latents = 10 | .action_max = 8 | .share_k = 0 | .critic_flows = true | .critic_warmup = 3 | .noise_sigma = $noise | .noise_hold_steps = 20 | .tau_s = 1 | .group = 4 | .links_per_iteration = 8 | .lr = $lr | .clip = $clip | .copies = [2, 4] | .competition = "diverse" | .alone = 0.35 | .compete = 0.6 | .seed = $seed | .iterations = 120 | .eval_every = 20 | .time_budget_s = 14400' "$OUT/setup/ppo-base.json" > "$S"; uv run expliccit train ppo "$S" "$OUT/$T" --build "$UML" --workers "$WORKERS"
collect: uv run python experiments/net2_ppo_report.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/ctl-*; uv run python experiments/settings_search.py "$OUT" "$OUT"/ctl-*; cat "$OUT/settings-search.md" "$OUT/summary.md" > "$OUT/both.md"; mv "$OUT/both.md" "$OUT/summary.md"
